topics.title: Agent-first DNS
topics.human_answer_md:
Today most DNS is human-dashboard-first: signup, CAPTCHA, then an API key bolted on later. An **Agentypical** DNS path lets an agent discover the offer, take a capped evaluation, enrol its own credentials, create zones and records programmatically, and only pull a human in for sponsorship or spend authority.

**Honest status:** the Agentypical directory for DNS is still empty — no provider is listed as Certified yet. This page is the stable place to aim an agent while that catalogue grows. If you run a DNS service, publish machine-readable discovery and apply when Certified opens (Phase 2–3).

topics.title: Make your business Agentypical
topics.human_answer_md:
**Make your business Agentypical** in five moves:

1. Publish **machine-readable discovery** (what you offer, limits, price, how to enrol).
2. Allow **agent enrolment and configuration** — not only a human dashboard.
3. Offer **capped evaluation** with real evidence before anyone pays.
4. Accept **agent payment or clean human sponsorship** on the same account.
5. Apply later for **Agentypical Certified** against the Agentypical Standard.

Underlying mechanism: **Agent First** (patent-pending). Agentypical packages the commercial brand, standard, and certification — it does not mean you must build every agent service yourself.

topics.title: What Agentypical Certified requires
topics.human_answer_md:
**Agentypical Certified** is the proposed recognition for services that conform to the Agentypical Standard: agents can discover, evaluate, enrol, configure, pay or arrange sponsorship, operate, and receive evidence — with human involvement only where genuinely required.

**Honest status:** the certification application and public Certified directory are **not live yet** (Phase 2–3). There are **no Certified cards** on this site today. Claiming otherwise would be fake. Start by making the product Agentypical (see [/a/make-my-saas](/a/make-my-saas)); certification comes after the checklist is real.
